dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors s and p indexed by Fin n, this defines the vector A with A_i = h^3 s_i + (epsilon h^2) p_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Euclidean norm is the left-hand side of the second asserted inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors s and p indexed by Fin n, this defines the vector B with B_i = h^3 s_i + (epsilon h^3) p_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Euclidean norm is the left-hand side of the first asserted inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: For x : Fin n → Real, this is sqrt(sum over i in Fin n of x_i^2), namely the Euclidean 2-norm of x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every occurrence involving scheme, perturbation, A, or B as an explicit Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is pointwise vector addition: (x + y)_i = x_i + y_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the two scaled vector terms in A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is scalar multiplication of a vector: (a x)_i = a x_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the h^3-scaled scheme vectors and the epsilon h^2- or epsilon h^3-scaled perturbation vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For x : Fin n → Real, this is the finite sum sum_i x_i^2 over all indices i in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the sum of squares beneath each square root in D003.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: And is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The nested conjunction requires all three inequalities to hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural-number indices i satisfying 0 ≤ i < n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes scheme and perturbation n-component real vectors and fixes the index set of every sum.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This selects the heterogeneous addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied real instance, every use here is ordinary real addition; through D004 it also produces pointwise vector addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This selects the heterogeneous multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied real instance, every use here is ordinary real multiplication, including coefficients, norm bounds, and pointwise scalar multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This selects exponentiation from an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the exact real powers h^2 and h^3 and the component squares x_i^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This selects the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instance, it expresses 0 ≤ h, h ≤ 1, 0 ≤ epsilon, and each of the three real inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies natural-number powers in a monoid by repeated multiplication, with exponent zero giving the multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it gives the conventional natural powers used for h^2 and h^3.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nat is the type of natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The dimension n is an arbitrary natural number, and the exponents 2 and 3 are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural-number literal in a type equipped with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constants 0 and 1 and the natural exponents 2 and 3 appearing in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 1 using a type's distinguished multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it supplies the upper endpoint 1 in the hypothesis h ≤ 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All scalars, vector components, norms, coefficients, and inequalities in the proposition are over exact real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the ordinary addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all scalar additions and the componentwise additions used to form A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the ordinary order relation ≤ on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the meanings of the three hypotheses and the three asserted bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the natural powers used for h^2, h^3, and component squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary multiplication of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every product of coefficients, components, and norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number 1 as the multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the constant in the assumption h ≤ 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number 0 as the additive identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the constants in the assumptions 0 ≤ h and 0 ≤ epsilon and is also the value of empty sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 0 using a type's distinguished additive identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real it supplies the lower bound 0 in the nonnegativity hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a homogeneous Add operation into the corresponding HAdd operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures HAdd.hAdd on real operands is ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a homogeneous Mul operation into the corresponding HMul operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures HMul.hMul on real operands is ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts a Pow operation into the corresponding HPow operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the real powers by natural exponents available through HPow.hPow.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural-number literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural exponents 2 and 3 to the power operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.sqrt x is the nonnegative square root of the nonnegative part of x; for x ≥ 0 it is the ordinary nonnegative square root of x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its arguments here are sums of squares and hence nonnegative, so D003 is exactly the usual Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips Fin n with its finite enumeration of all n indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the norm's sum to range over every vector coordinate exactly once.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forms the finite sum of a function's values over a finite set using the additive commutative monoid operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes the exact sum of squared coordinates in D006.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite type, Finset.univ is the finite set containing every element of that type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes D006 sum over all indices in Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the additive commutative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines finite real summation in D006, including the empty sum as 0.

binders: n is an arbitrary natural number, possibly 0.
h and epsilon are arbitrary real numbers.
scheme and perturbation are arbitrary functions Fin n → Real, equivalently arbitrary n-component real vectors.
conclusions: Let B_i = h^3 scheme_i + epsilon h^3 perturbation_i. Then ||B||_2 ≤ h^3(||scheme||_2 + epsilon ||perturbation||_2).
Let A_i = h^3 scheme_i + epsilon h^2 perturbation_i. Then ||A||_2 ≤ h^3 ||scheme||_2 + epsilon h^2 ||perturbation||_2.
mathematical_definitions: For any x : Fin n → Real, ||x||_2 means sqrt(sum_{i in Fin n} x_i^2).
A is the pointwise vector h^3 scheme + (epsilon h^2) perturbation.
B is the pointwise vector h^3 scheme + (epsilon h^3) perturbation.
All additions, multiplications, powers, square roots, sums, and inequalities are exact real operations.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every dimension n, every h in the closed interval [0,1], every nonnegative epsilon, and every pair of real n-vectors scheme and perturbation, three bounds hold simultaneously: the Euclidean norm of h^3 scheme + epsilon h^3 perturbation is at most h^3 times the sum of the norm of scheme and epsilon times the norm of perturbation; the Euclidean norm of h^3 scheme + epsilon h^2 perturbation is at most h^3 times the norm of scheme plus epsilon h^2 times the norm of perturbation; and the first bound's right-hand side is no greater than the second bound's right-hand side.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The bounds are asserted only under 0 ≤ h ≤ 1 and epsilon ≥ 0. Because these assumptions occur as implications, the declaration imposes no conclusion when any assumption fails.
The dimension n may be 0. In that case Fin 0 is empty, both vectors are empty, every displayed norm is 0, and all three inequalities reduce to 0 ≤ 0.
The endpoint h = 0 is allowed. Then every scaled vector and every displayed bound is 0, so all conclusions are degenerate equalities.
The case epsilon = 0 is allowed and removes every perturbation contribution.
There is no positive lower bound on h, no positive-dimension requirement, and no upper bound on epsilon.
Scheme and perturbation are completely arbitrary real vectors; no componentwise bounds, normalization, dependence, or relationship between them is encoded.
There are no existential quantifiers or witness choices; all data are universally quantified.
The proposition encodes only exact Euclidean-norm upper bounds. It does not encode floating-point rounding, an algorithm, approximation semantics, relative error, lower bounds, or equality claims.
